program: Whole exact ng_program input object in every state.
constructor_wire: NGControl/NGFrame/NGEvent each is one-key object {constructor_name: {each declared payload name: recursively decoded value}}; exact payload names/orders from PUBLIC-LT-API.

values.UInt: JSON integer in one-key UInt object
values.Bool: JSON boolean in one-key Bool object
values.Nominal: one-key Nominal object with type_id,ctor_id,ordered fields

map: All bindings as array of {name_id:integer,value:NGValue}, sorted by integer name_id; no deletion/overwrite.
sequences: All ordered rows retained; frames top-first; events cumulative append order.
scalar_distinction: Integer/Boolean are different types; no float/finite-value coercion.
states: Every complete chronological boundary from initial through after-each and final, without duplicated final.
expected_ordinal_authoring: Oracle author independently derives ordinal array from own complete states; do not obtain it from actual wire.
basis: Public constructor declarations and existing CompleteKWire representation contract; no model rule or semantic evaluator supplied.
